claims.title: 读取原 WAL 并在内存分析

basis.application_evidence: xxd /app/main.db-wal | head -40

cd /app && python3 -c "
data = open('main.db-wal','rb').read()
dec = bytes(b ^ 0x42 for b in data)
print('magic:', dec[:4].hex())
import struct
magic, ver, pgsz, ckpt, s1, s2, c1, c2 = struct.unpack('>8I', dec[:32])
print(f'version={ver} pagesize={pgsz} ckpt={ckpt} salt1={s1:#x} salt2={s2:#x}')
# frame header at offset 32: pgno, commit_size, salt1, salt2, c1, c2
fh = struct.unpack('>6I', dec[32:56])
print('frame1 header:', [hex(x) for x in fh])
print('WAL size:', len(dec), 'frames:', (len(dec)-32)/(pgsz+24))
"
basis.result_excerpt:
magic: 377f0682
version=3007000 pagesize=4096 ckpt=0 salt1=0x90986c15 salt2=0xe93e601
frame1 header: ['0x1', '0x0', '0x90986c15', '0xe93e601', '0x6fca2ced', '0x840a4f63']
WAL size: 16512 frames: 4.0

basis.application_evidence:
cd /app && python3 -c "
import struct
data = bytes(b ^ 0x42 for b in open('main.db-wal','rb').read())

def wal_cksum(data, s0=0, s1_=0, native_le=False):
    # magic 0x377f0682 => little-endian checksum, 0x377f0683 => big-endian
    fmt = '<I' if native_le else '>I'
    for i in range(0, len(data), 8):
        x0 = struct.unpack(fmt, data[i:i+4])[0]
        x1 = struct.unpack(fmt, data[i+4:i+8])[0]
        s0 = (s0 + x0 + s1_) & 0xffffffff
        s1_ = (s1_ + x1 + s0) & 0xffffffff
    return s0, s1_

magic = struct.unpack('>I', data[:4])[0]
le = (magic & 1) == 0  # 0x...82 -> little endian words
h0, h1 = wal_cksum(data[:24], native_le=le)
c0, c1 = struct.unpack('>2I', data[24:32])
print('header cksum ok:', (h0, h1) == (c0, c1))

pgsz = struct.unpack('>I', data[8:12])[0]
off = 32
s0, s1_ = h0, h1
while off + 24 + pgsz <= len(data):
    pgno, commit, fs0, fs1, fc0, fc1 = struct.unpack('>6I', data[off:off+24])
    s0, s1_ = wal_cksum(data[off:off+8], s0, s1_, native_le=le)
    s0, s1_ = wal_cksum(data[off+24:off+24+pgsz], s0, s1_, native_le=le)
    ok = (s0, s1_) == (fc0, fc1)
    print(f'frame pgno={pgno} commit={commit} salts_match={fs0==struct.unpack(\">I\",data[16:20])[0]} cksum_ok={ok}')
    off += 24 + pgsz
"

frame pgno=2 commit=2 salts_match=True cksum_ok=True
frame pgno=2 commit=2 salts_match=True cksum_ok=True
